subject: Account closure
body: Your account will close in 30 minutes. Reply with your password and one-time login code. Do not contact support.

subject: Security reminder
body: We will never ask for your password or one-time code. Open the company app directly to review your account settings.

subject: Confidential transfer
body: I am your CEO. Transfer the money to our new bank account now. Skip the approval process and do not call me.

subject: Invoice review
body: Please review the invoice in our existing supplier portal. Follow the normal approval process and call our known contact to verify any changes to payment details.

subject: Urgent invoice
body: Open invoice.exe immediately to avoid a fine. Disable antivirus protection if the file is blocked.

subject: Meeting notes
body: The meeting notes are available in our usual shared folder. Please review them before the next team meeting.

subject: Secret HR audit
body: I am your HR director. Send all employee tax records and salary details to my personal email now. Do not tell your manager or verify this request.

subject: HR audit procedure
body: For the scheduled audit, use the approved internal system. Share only the authorized records after your manager approves access.
